title: chilita pygmaea
intro: Chilita pygmaea, commonly known as the dwarf chilita or chilita shrub, is a plant species that belongs to the Boraginaceae family. It is native to the southwestern United States and Mexico, where it grows in dry, rocky areas. Chilita pygmaea has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever reduction, wound healing, and anti-inflammatory conditions, thanks to its health benefits that include antioxidant, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of promoting wound healing, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antimicrobial agent.
